programs.programName: UAE Family Residence Visa (Sponsoring Family Members)
programs.eligibilitySummary: Expatriate resident holding a valid UAE employment or investment residence permit sponsoring spouse, sons up to age 25, unmarried daughters of any age, and parents.
programs.legalBasis: UAE Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 on Foreigners Entry and Residence Regulations

programs.programName: UAE 10-Year Golden Visa (Real Estate & Business Investors)
programs.eligibilitySummary: Property investors owning unmortgaged UAE real estate (or mortgaged with approved UAE bank) worth at least AED 2,000,000 (~$545,000 USD), or commercial business investors/entrepreneurs.
